clue.text: Ruth left speech in confusion

parts.note: Babe Ruth, the American baseball star, supplies his nickname

explanation.surface: Someone called Ruth walks out mid-talk, flustered.
explanation.walkthrough: Babe Ruth was a famous American baseball player, so 'Ruth' prompts his first name.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical Tower ended in a jumble of tongues, so the name now means a confused din of voices.

clue.text: Foremost of botanists, say, presented with prize flower

indicators.note: foremost points to the leading letter of the word botanists

parts.note: to say something is to utter it
a cup is a trophy awarded as a prize

explanation.surface: A leading botanist wins an award for a bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: A common yellow meadow bloom of the genus Ranunculus.

clue.text: Offer includes gym for a man, perhaps

indicators.note: includes means the offer word takes the gym letters inside it

parts.note: a bid is an offer at auction
PE, physical education, is school gym

explanation.surface: A proposal that throws in gym membership for a gentleman.
explanation.definitionFit: A man is one example of a two-legged animal, hence 'perhaps' marking a definition by example.

clue.text: Head of laboratory getting paid for knowledge

indicators.note: head of means the opening letter of laboratory

parts.note: earning is getting paid for work

explanation.surface: A lab director is rewarded for expertise.
explanation.definitionFit: Erudition gained by study is a synonym for knowledge.

clue.text: Fees split by game ladies

indicators.note: split by means the fees word is broken open with the game word inside

parts.note: dues are fees, as for membership
chess is a board game

explanation.surface: Charges divided among ladies who play a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Noblewomen of high rank are titled ladies.

clue.text: Article put in study for college administrator

indicators.note: put in tells us the article goes inside the study word

parts.note: a den is a private room for study
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An essay is placed in the study of a college official.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior academic official in charge of a faculty or college discipline.

clue.text: There's much talk from me about mad character on TV

indicators.note: on in a down clue places the TV word after what precedes it

parts.note: C, circa, is the abbreviation for about
the Mad Hatter from Alice in Wonderland
the box is slang for television

explanation.surface: A talkative person rambles about a crazy TV character.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the whole first half, voiced by the answer itself. BOX is British slang for the television.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who talks incessantly is the one producing so much talk.

clue.text: Get away from European scene?

parts.note: a scape is a view or scene, as in landscape

explanation.surface: Fleeing a scene on the Continent.
explanation.definitionFit: To elude or break free of something, as prisoners flee a jail.

clue.text: Whisky, for example, taken before good picnic food?

indicators.note: taken before places these pieces ahead of the good letter

parts.note: Scotch is whisky from Scotland

explanation.surface: A dram of whisky is drunk before the picnic sandwiches.
explanation.walkthrough: A Scotch egg is a British snack: a boiled egg wrapped in sausage meat and breadcrumbs.
explanation.definitionFit: This sausage-wrapped snack is a staple of British outdoor meals.

clue.text: Give out letters in magic formula

definitions.meaning: to name the letters of a word in order

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: naming letters of a word, and a witch's incantation.

clue.text: Finest fruit for organisation chief

definitions.meaning: read literally, the very best yellow fruit
the boss, the most important person in a group

explanation.definitionFit: An informal idiom for the boss, read literally as a premium piece of fruit.

clue.text: Nearby block, unventilated

explanation.surface: A neighbouring block of flats with no fresh air.
explanation.definitionFit: Three senses: near at hand, to shut off, and stuffy and airless.

clue.text: What Gog and Magog do for Armageddon?

parts.note: both names finish on the letter G

explanation.surface: Gog and Magog are biblical forces gathering for the final battle.
explanation.walkthrough: Gog and Magog fight at the end of the world in Revelation, but the clue really means that each name ends in the letter G.
explanation.definitionFit: Armageddon is the final battle, the end of the world.

clue.text: Uncharacteristic year in capital abroad

indicators.note: in places the year letter inside the rearranged capital
abroad suggests the word capital is scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: An unusual year in a foreign capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abroad' turns CAPITAL into ATPICAL, and Y goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Not typical, so out of keeping with the usual character.

clue.text: Deal an effective blow and refuse to work in the house

parts.note: workers strike when they refuse to work
at home means in the house

explanation.surface: Hit hard and then stay at home rather than work.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom meaning to land a blow or point with full force.

clue.text: Cashier not working for retail enterprise

indicators.note: working suggests the letters are being worked into a new shape

explanation.surface: A shop cashier who is off duty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cashier not working' looks like an idle employee; 'working' is the anagram signal on CASHIER NOT.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of shops under one owner forms one retail business.

clue.text: A good deal is needed for this call at whist

definitions.meaning: in solo whist, a bid to win nine tricks

explanation.surface: A strong hand is required to make this bid at cards.
explanation.walkthrough: In solo whist, the bid called abundance promises nine of the thirteen tricks.
explanation.definitionFit: It means plenty, and is also a named bid in solo whist.

clue.text: Cry coming from small page

parts.note: wee is Scottish for small

explanation.surface: A young page boy starts to sob.
explanation.definitionFit: To shed tears is a synonym for crying.

clue.text: Work of little merit in vessel, British tanker

parts.note: a pot is a cooking vessel
an oiler is a ship carrying oil

explanation.surface: A cheap novel about a British oil tanker.
explanation.definitionFit: A hack novel written just to earn a living is a work of slight value.

clue.text: Everyone attending is of normal intelligence

parts.note: all means everyone
present is being there

explanation.surface: Every person present is reasonably bright.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom meaning mentally sound, having one's wits about one.

clue.text: Fruit, round almost

indicators.note: almost means the word for round loses its final letter

parts.note: plump means rounded, chubby

explanation.surface: A piece of fruit that is nearly spherical.
explanation.definitionFit: A stone fruit, purple or yellow, from a Prunus tree.

clue.text: I share in predicament caused by a flame

indicators.note: in puts the share piece inside the predicament word

parts.note: a plight is a difficult situation
a lot is a portion or share

explanation.surface: Someone shares a difficult situation started by a fire.
explanation.definitionFit: A small permanent jet of gas in a boiler or stove used to ignite the main burner.

clue.text: Material's marvellous, very amusing mostly

parts.note: fab is short for fabulous, marvellous

indicators.note: mostly means the amusing word drops its last letter

parts.note: rich means highly amusing, as in 'that's rich'

explanation.surface: Praise for some hilarious cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Cloth or textile is a general synonym for material.

clue.text: Ashamed lefty confronted

parts.note: a red is a left-winger, a communist
to face is to confront

explanation.surface: A socialist is embarrassed when challenged.
explanation.definitionFit: Blushing with embarrassment shows shame.

clue.text: Right occasion to turn up or send money, maybe

indicators.note: turn up in a down clue means the occasion word reads upwards

parts.note: a time is an occasion

explanation.surface: The right moment comes to pay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to turn up' reverses TIME to EMIT.
explanation.definitionFit: To transmit a payment; maybe because it has other senses.

clue.text: Wounds to back? Company will supply plaster

indicators.note: to back means the wounds word is turned round

parts.note: cuts are wounds

explanation.surface: Injuries to someone's back will be dressed by a firm.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine plaster used to coat walls or for mouldings.

clue.text: Blow caught hooligan

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a lout is a boorish yob

explanation.surface: A thug is arrested and struck.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a clout is a heavy hit or punch, as in a clout round the ear.

clue.text: Speak about short time in lodge

indicators.note: about means the speak word surrounds the short time

parts.note: to say is to speak
T abbreviates time

explanation.surface: Talk briefly about a stint in a cabin.
explanation.definitionFit: To lodge somewhere is to reside there for a while.

clue.text: Small island about to disappear

indicators.note: to disappear means the about letters are removed from the island

parts.note: Minorca is a Balearic island
ca, circa, means about

explanation.surface: A tiny island is about to vanish beneath the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Lesser or of little importance, a synonym for small.

clue.text: Active, new hotline box office initially installed

indicators.note: installed means the box office initials are set inside
new tells us the word hotline is remade in a fresh order
initially takes the opening letters of box and office

explanation.surface: A busy new phone line has been put in at the theatre ticket desk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges the hotline letters to ONTHEIL, and 'installed' sets the box office initials inside, before the final IL.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for being actively under way, like a simmering pot.

clue.text: Come to the East in attempt to expose betrayal

indicators.note: in places these pieces inside the attempt word

parts.note: a try is an attempt
to reach a place is to come to it

explanation.surface: An expedition eastward attempts to uncover treachery.
explanation.definitionFit: Disloyalty or deceit against those who trust one is treason.

clue.text: Some Aberdeen terriers put down

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A few Scottish dogs are put to sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put down' suggests putting the dogs to sleep, but here it means to record in writing.
explanation.definitionFit: To record something in a register or ledger is to write it in.
